stop_conditions: A bound source, allocation, assignment, factor, toolchain, tool path, or generator hash differs.
A selected source is absent, not single-stream lossless PCM, or has a native channel count outside one or two.
A provider window is empty or lies outside the selected source.
An assigned trim input is shorter than 500 ms or an assigned duration-prefix input is shorter than 3 s.
A feasibility failure would be hidden by pooled counts or repaired by silent reassignment.
Waveform samples, mechanism features, candidate scores, or unopened labels would be read.
The two complete private or public reports differ byte-for-byte.
The work volume falls below the 15 GiB reserve.
